geometry_model.validation_basis: reference calibration comparison; not independent predictive validation
geometry_model.surface_recombination_fraction: assumed 100% of the effective junction-SRH term; not independently extracted
geometry_model.backgate_coupling: delta_psi = Cb/(Cf+Cb) * VBG; effective BJT source injection P = ni^2 * exp(delta_psi/VT) * expm1(u/VT)
geometry_model.backgate_assumption: uncalibrated lumped electrostatic BJT body-bias closure; no separate back-channel or 2D Poisson solution
geometry_model.body_potential: psi_body = u - VT*ln(1+delta_inj/Nbody) + delta_psi; body contact voltage is u, not psi_body
geometry_model.drain_field_approximation: original r-based collector field retained; no independent backgate-induced drain-field correction
geometry_model.body_capacitance_scaling: Cf + Cb - Cb0; Cb0 is reference-calibration counterterm

warnings: X1: relaxation oscillator — fed by 1 nA (current source) with 1 fF across the cell, the load line crosses only the negative-resistance branch (fold currents I_LU = 14.42 pA, I_LD = 16.66 nA): V_DS saws between ≈ V_LD and V_LU with a quasi-static period ≈ 1.114 µs (~33 latch-ups in t_stop; the fold lags lengthen it by a few %)

X1: current-biased above the HRS (the load line at t = 0 does not cross the HRS, so the DC operating point would be an equilibrium on the negative-resistance branch or the LRS): the transient starts from discharged capacitors, as if the sources were switched on at t = 0 (tran.initial = 'auto'; 'op' uses the DC operating point)
